thread:
sophia: quick ping — opened a tiny tokenizer tweak for nova-3b onboarding. should be low risk but affects special-case splitting for emojis. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/842 can someone review before tomorrow's merge window? tests green locally. cc @matt @lina

matt: looking now, will run the tokenizer smoke tests.

lina: thanks — can you paste a short example input that changed behavior? want to add to unit test.

sophia: sure — example: 'I ❤️ Redwood' used to be tokenized as [\'I\',\'❤️\',\'Redwood\'] now it becomes [\'I\',\'\u2764\uFE0F\',\'Redwood\'] — fixed by normalizing emoji variants. patch is small:
```py
# normalize heart variants to canonical form
text = text.replace('\\u2764\\uFE0F','❤️')
```
added comment + test.

ci-bot: build passed — unit tests 124/124, flake8 warning in tokenizer.py: line 78: E201 whitespace after '('.

sophia: thanks CI — pushing a quick lint fix.

aaron: re: embeddings — does this change affect embedding hashing? can we run compare on sample set? i can run tomorrow morning.

matt: ran smoke tests, found one failing snapshot in detokenize step. small tweak recommended, i'll push suggestion in PR review.

sophia: added matt's tweak, and lint fix. pushed. ready for final lgtm.

deploy-bot: merge window for model-configs opens 2026-03-18T14:00Z — ensure approvals by then.

lina: LGTM from me, small change and tests added. :shipit: 

matt: LGTM.

sophia: thanks all — merging after wait period. will follow up if embeddings diffs show issues.
